reference: There is no matching GNU CLI or independent command oracle for this loadable's generic-netlink API (the source catalog records no program/applet counterpart). Runnable expectations are contract checks against Bash's documented type/help builtins and the genl help text documented by the loadable. The ctrl operations are deferred because invoking them would issue NETLINK_GENERIC requests, which this suite is forbidden to perform.
coverage: Executed coverage is Bash availability/help metadata only; no operational behavior is counted as a pass.
Bash reports genl as a loadable builtin through type metadata.
Bash help exposes the documented ctrl list, ctrl get name, and ctrl get id forms.
Help metadata identifies this as a read-only generic-netlink controller reader.
exclusions: No parity case is claimed because the catalog documents no matching GNU CLI or applet oracle.
No operation is invoked: even read-only controller queries send NETLINK_GENERIC requests and real kernel state would not be a deterministic independent fixture.

Deferred operations need a disposable VM with an isolated generic-netlink controller fixture or a reviewed mock that returns deterministic family, operation, capability, and multicast-group attributes.

cases.purpose: Verify the Bash metadata contract that genl is registered as a builtin, rather than relying on an external executable in PATH.
Verify that help advertises each documented controller command form. The required strings are taken from genl's documented interface.
cases.script:
h=$(help genl)
for item in 'genl ctrl list' 'genl ctrl get name NAME' 'genl ctrl get id ID'; do
  case $h in
    *"$item"*) printf '%s\n' "$item" ;;
    *) exit 1 ;;
  esac
done
cases.stdout:
genl ctrl list
genl ctrl get name NAME
genl ctrl get id ID
